modes.cue_notes: With straight legs and a wide stance, hinge from the hip over the straight front leg, reaching the front hand toward the shin or floor and the top hand toward the sky, stacking the shoulders in one plane.

breathing_cues.entering: Exhale to hinge at the front hip crease, extending the torso long over the straight front leg.
breathing_cues.holding: Inhale to lengthen through the crown and reaching top arm, exhale to root evenly through both feet.
breathing_cues.exiting: Inhale to engage the front thigh and rise the torso back to vertical, leading with the top arm.

prop_free_variation: Rest the front hand on a shin or block-height support instead of the floor to keep the torso long rather than rounding.
